entries.summary: A new retention class codex-session-store expires the Codex rollouts that agentUserContext: excluded keeps under <Agent home>/.byok/codex, by last write, with the new DaemonConfig.storage.retention.ttlMs['codex-session-store'] (default 31 days, at least session-ledger plus one day). It replaces the exempt agent-runtime-sessions class. A thread idle past the TTL is pruned only while its Agent home is idle, so a thread a running task holds is kept; resuming a pruned thread fails closed through the existing non-retryable missing-thread path. Rollouts that used to stay until the Host removed the Agent home now expire; set the TTL higher to keep them longer.
